rules.name: Lakehouse Table Names Must Follow Medallion Convention
rules.description: Returns table names that do not follow bronze/silver/gold schema or prefix naming. WARNING: This rule was AI-generated and is untested.

sqlquery: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA + '.' + TABLE_NAME AS TableName FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND LOWER(TABLE_SCHEMA) NOT IN ('bronze','silver','gold') AND LOWER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE 'bronze[_]%' AND LOWER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE 'silver[_]%' AND LOWER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE 'gold[_]%'
